units.source_text: 可是，传到我父亲——第十二代纪之国屋伊兵卫的时候，

en.t: However, by the time it passed to my father, the twelfth-generation Kinokuniya Ihei,

units.source_text: 他不得不变卖这套雏人偶，可以想象当时我家落魄到了什么地步。

en.t: he had no choice but to sell this set of hina dolls, which shows how far our family had fallen by then.

units.source_text: 不管怎么样，德川幕府政权瓦解之后，也就只有加贺藩降低了赋税。

en.t: In any case, after the Tokugawa shogunate collapsed, only the Kaga domain reduced its taxes.

units.source_text: 不过，也只是从三千两的税赋里减少一百两罢了。

en.t: Even so, it merely reduced the levy of three thousand ryo by one hundred ryo.

units.source_text: 这之后，家里有遇上了两三次祝融灾祸。

en.t: After that, the family also suffered two or three fires.

units.source_text: 就连经营蝙蝠伞的营生也大不如前了，

en.t: Even the umbrella business was no longer doing nearly as well as before,

units.source_text: 因此为了解决家里人的温饱问题，只能慢慢变卖一些像样的家当了。

en.t: so, in order to keep the family fed and clothed, they could only gradually sell off some of their better household possessions.
